notes: 1. CP portal login URL is https://uat-web.xrportal.in/login (bare /login is the CP / Growth-Partner entry point). The Leads module lives at https://uat-web.xrportal.in/leads and requires an authenticated CP session (role ID 3). CP auth is Mobile-OTP only (no password): UAT mobile = 8888888888, CP static OTP = 147258.

2. GLOSSARY (Leads): 'Lead' = a buyer the CP has invited/captured who has not yet completed a paid registration. The Leads table shows one row per invited/sent buyer with columns: S.No, Applicant Name, Applicant Phone, Status, Date of Sent, CP Name, CP HV Code, CP Mobile, Action. 'HV Code' = the CP's unique referral code (hvCode, e.g. HV00026050) used to credit the CP for a referral. 'Master CP' (isLeadCp=true) sees their own + sub-CP leads; 'Member CP' (leadCpId set) sees only their own.

3. LEAD STATUS values observed in the live UI (visual-memory leads-loaded.png + leads-status-dropdown-open.png, 3 options): 'Sent' (orange/yellow pill — referral link shared, buyer not yet registered), 'Registered' (green pill — buyer paid the token amount, registration complete), 'Refunded' (red/pink pill — registration cancelled/refunded). These three pills are the only statuses captured; if more appear live, flag and extend ([VERIFY WITH DEV]).

4. ROW ACTIONS (two icon buttons per row, both button.reset-btn, sticky-right cell): icon 1 = 'Resend Notification' (paper-airplane SVG, <title>Resend Notification</title>) — re-sends the referral notification (SMS/WhatsApp) to the buyer via the backend; icon 2 = 'Copy Link' (document/copy SVG, <title>Copy Link</title>) — writes the per-lead referral URL https://uat.xrportal.in/ref/<token> to the system clipboard. There is NO 'Convert to Registration' control visible in the live UI (see DOC_DRIFT-002).

5. SILENT-UX IS NOT A BUG. For 'Resend Notification' and 'Copy Link', verify the backend SIDE-EFFECT (resend API call fired / referral URL present on the clipboard) before judging Pass/Fail — do NOT treat a missing toast/confirmation as a defect. NOTE: visual-memory INDEX prose says 'no toast observed', but the action-attempt sidecar (_leads-action-attempts.json) records outcome='toast' for both icons, so a toast MAY be shown. The presence/text of any toast is [VERIFY WITH DEV]; the authoritative pass criterion is the backend side-effect, not the toast. A previously-filed 'silent UX' bug against this module was RETRACTED — do not re-encode it as an expected failure.

6. MUTATION SAFETY. 'Resend Notification' WRITES a live notification and can flip a 'Refunded' lead's underlying registration back to Open with no audit trail (existing baseline CP_LEAD_031, CP_LEAD_045). Capturing/sending a lead (registration-link) and converting a lead create live records. ALL such WRITE tests carry [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] and require explicit user authorisation before running on UAT — never invent buyer mobiles/registration numbers, never auto-run on a real fixture.

7. [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] = a disposable UAT record/state (a throwaway buyer mobile to invite, a lead in a specific status, a second CP/Member-CP account, an aged JWT, an API bearer token, DB read access) must be supplied AND user-authorised before executing the test.
8. [VERIFY WITH DEV] = behaviour not confirmed in BRD/FRD/FS or not captured in visual-memory; confirm before treating Pass/Fail as authoritative.

9. DOC_DRIFT-002 — TABLE COLUMNS. The FS (CP-FS-Leads-Management §1.4) and BRD/FRD describe LSQ-style columns (Lead Name, Contact Details, Lead Source, Status/Stage, Last Activity). The LIVE UI (visual-memory _leads-dom-inspect.json tableHeaders) instead shows: S.No, Applicant Name, Applicant Phone, Status, Date of Sent, CP Name, CP HV Code, CP Mobile, Action. Live implementation wins: TCs assert the observed columns. BRD/FRD/FS should be updated to the live column set in this pipeline step.

10. DOC_DRIFT-003 — NO CONVERT-TO-REGISTRATION CONTROL. BRD §1.5.3 / FS §1.5.3 / FRD Module-2 state the CP can 'convert a lead to a registration directly from this screen'. The live Leads screen exposes only two row actions (Resend Notification, Copy Link) and NO convert button (visual-memory INDEX + _leads-row-deep-inspect.json). Conversion appears to happen via the Dashboard 'Register Customer' flow, not on /leads. Live UI wins: convert-on-/leads TCs are marked [VERIFY WITH DEV] and assert the control is absent. Update docs to match.

11. DOC_DRIFT-004 — DATA SOURCE. BRD/FS say leads are 'synced from LeadSquared (LSQ)'. The existing baseline TCs (CP_LEAD_026, CP_LEAD_034, CP_LEAD_040) and live behaviour indicate the list is served from the portal's own registration_drafts / Registration tables (Refresh re-fetches from the DB, search uses JSON_EXTRACT on draft JSON), not a live LSQ pull. LSQ is EXCLUDED from scope (CLAUDE.md constraint 1) — these TCs assert only the downstream portal effect, never call LSQ. Treat the LSQ-sync wording as [VERIFY WITH DEV] / stale.

12. SEARCH: a single free-text input with placeholder 'Search Customer' (visual-memory) filters the table by Applicant Name or Applicant Phone. 'All Team Leads' dropdown (3 options) = team/Master-CP scope filter; 'Status' dropdown (3 options) = filter by lead status. Existing baseline notes a wildcard-injection gap (CP_LEAD_035: '%' returns all) — preserved as a security TC, not a passing case.

13. CP DATA ISOLATION (BRD §4.1 / §4.2): a CP sees only their own leads (brokerId = CP user id); Master CP additionally sees sub-CP leads; a Member CP cannot use a leadOwner filter for peers (baseline CP_LEAD_032/033 return 403). The unauthenticated POST /cp/registration security gap (BRD §9) and the missing ownership check on send-registration-link (CP_LEAD_030) are documented gaps, asserted as gaps — not as passing behaviour.

14. EXECUTION ORDER: run sub-modules top-to-bottom — Login & Landing → Table → Status Badges → Filters → Search → Row Actions → Pagination/Refresh → Lead Conversion → CP Isolation & Roles → Notifications → API & Backend → Error Handling & Empty States. Read-only TCs first; WRITE/destructive TCs (resend, capture, convert) last and only with authorisation.

tcs.scenario: To verify a Refunded lead's resend can silently flip it to Open (gap)
tcs.description: Verify the documented gap that 'Resend Notification' on a Refunded lead re-opens the underlying registration with no audit entry.

tcs.scenario: To verify the Refunded → Open flip is visible after refresh

3. Re-read the row status.
tcs.expected: The status change becomes visible after the Refresh re-fetch (the row moves out of 'Refunded'); the table does not live-update without a refresh. Documented gap — not correct UX.

tcs.scenario: To verify send-registration-link has no ownership check (gap)
tcs.description: Verify the documented security gap that the send-registration-link endpoint does not verify the lead belongs to the calling CP.

tcs.expected: Per the baseline, the call SUCCEEDS with no ownership check — a documented security gap (a CP can send a link for another CP's buyer). Assert this as a gap to be fixed; do NOT treat success as correct. [VERIFY WITH DEV] confirm the missing ownership check still reproduces.

tcs.scenario: To verify whether a Convert-to-Registration control is present on /leads

tcs.scenario: To verify clicking a lead row opens a lead detail view

tcs.scenario: To verify the convert flow opens a pre-filled registration form
tcs.description: Verify that the documented convert action opens the registration form pre-filled with the lead's details.

tcs.description: Verify that completing the convert flow creates a Registration record with brokerId = the converting CP.

tcs.scenario: To verify CP data isolation — a CP sees only their own leads

tcs.scenario: To verify a Master CP cannot filter leadOwner to an unrelated CP (403)
tcs.description: Verify that a Master CP requesting leads for an unrelated CP via a leadOwner filter is rejected with 403.

2. Read the HTTP status.
tcs.testData: [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] Master CP token, unrelated CP id
tcs.expected: The backend returns 403 — a Master CP can only scope to its own sub-CPs, not an unrelated CP (data-isolation, BRD §4).

tcs.scenario: To verify a Member CP cannot use leadOwner to see peers
tcs.description: Verify that a Member CP cannot use the leadOwner filter to view a peer Member CP's leads.

tcs.expected: The request is rejected (403 / empty) — a Member CP sees only their own leads and cannot scope to peers (BRD §4 isolation).

tcs.scenario: To verify a WhatsApp failure does NOT roll back the lead capture
tcs.description: Verify the documented behaviour that a notification dispatch failure leaves the captured lead intact (fire-and-forget).

tcs.expected: No notification is dispatched to the mapped SM on lead creation — a documented gap (asserted as a gap, not a passing case). [VERIFY WITH DEV] confirm whether SM notification was intended.

tcs.scenario: To verify the Resend Notification action does not duplicate the registration
tcs.description: Verify that re-sending a notification re-dispatches the message without creating a second Registration/lead row.

tcs.scenario: To verify the same CP capturing a duplicate lead returns 409

2. Read the response.
tcs.expected: The backend rejects the duplicate with HTTP 409 (duplicate check, BRD §4.2). No second draft/lead is created.

tcs.scenario: To verify two different CPs CAN capture the same buyer (design/gap)
tcs.description: Verify the documented behaviour that two different CPs may each capture the same buyer for the same project.

tcs.scenario: To verify a buyer with an existing paid registration cannot be re-captured

tcs.scenario: To verify the leads list endpoint requires a valid CP token
tcs.description: Verify that the leads list API rejects an unauthenticated request.

[VERIFY WITH DEV] confirm.

tcs.scenario: To verify the search endpoint sanitises injection at the API layer
tcs.description: Verify how the leads search backend handles SQL/wildcard injection sent directly to the API (bypassing the UI input).

[VERIFY WITH DEV] confirm parameterisation and that isolation is never broken.
